collection.title: Renault Wind 2010 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Wind 2010 to 2013 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
